questions.prompt: What happened when Wren cast the speed spell during the race?
choices: Everyone near Wren shot forward except Wren.
Only Wren raced ahead of every other runner.
Everyone near Wren stopped moving at once.
questions.answer: Everyone near Wren shot forward except Wren.
questions.evidenceText:
It worked on everyone near her.
Everyone shot forward very fast.
Except Wren.

questions.prompt: Why does Flint arrive at the finish from the wrong direction?
choices: Flint went left. Then left again. Then the Fog Marsh was ahead.
Flint followed Dewdrop across the Crystal Stream and stayed behind her.
Flint stopped beside Stone and waited for Stone to stand again.
questions.answer: Flint went left. Then left again. Then the Fog Marsh was ahead.
questions.evidenceText:
Flint went left.
Then left again.
Then the Fog Marsh was ahead of him.

questions.prompt: What does giving gold leaves to Dewdrop and Burrow show?
choices: There can be more than one kind of success.
Dewdrop's speed was the one result Luna rewarded.
Burrow won because his tunnel followed the planned course.
questions.answer: There can be more than one kind of success.
questions.rationale: Dewdrop crosses the finish line first, while Burrow appears beside the finish after travelling underground; each receives a gold leaf, showing there can be more than one kind of success.
questions.evidenceText:
Dewdrop won a gold leaf for finishing.
Burrow won a gold leaf for best route.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
Dewdrop crossed the finish line.
She had glided the whole way.
She was not wet.
She was not ruffled.
"Finished," said Dewdrop.

Then there was a rumbling.
Burrow came up through the ground.
Right beside the finish line.
